title: Matrioshka Brain
description: Wrap a star in nested shells of computronium and let it think.

puzzle.goal: A star of luminosity L is enclosed by computing shells; the outermost, of radius R, radiates everything to space as a black body. Every erased bit must leave as entropy, at kB ln 2 per bit, and black-body radiation of power L at temperature T carries entropy 4L/(3T) per second. Write the maximum rate of bit erasures, with the shell temperature fixed by radiative balance.
puzzle.name: Landauer-limited computation of a stellar shell
puzzle.ask: Find log₁₀ of the erasure rate (bits per second) for the Sun (L = 3.828e26 W) inside a shell at R = 1 AU = 1.496e11 m.

vars.\u03c3: radiation constant of a black body

puzzle.method: Radiative balance L = 4πR²σT⁴ gives T. The entropy outflow of thermal radiation is (4/3)L/T; divide by the entropy kB ln 2 per erased bit.
